title: Parsed Kampaku Skill Record
description: Internal runtime representation parsed from packages/contracts/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md. This is not the authored Agent Skills file format.

promptFragment.description: Markdown instruction body parsed from SKILL.md.

default.description: When true, every agent receives this skill automatically on bootstrap.

projectId.description: The project this capability is scoped to, or null for a seed skill every project may be given. A project-scoped skill is authored through the runtime (create_skill, or POST /api/v1/skills with `project`), is never a default, is never written into packages/contracts/skills, and is assignable only to a seat working for that project.

projectSlug.description: The scoped project's slug, resolved for display. `projectId` is what is stored; this is derived.
